behavior: Read a supplier quote through a fixed configured provider without persisting a purchase.

input.name: sku
input.constraint: 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, validated via PurchaseIdentity before HTTP; escaped as a URI path segment

sourceBinding.status: source-reconciled specification; no current runtime or compliance verdict

domainModelNotes: No Procurement domain-event object is emitted. GoodsReceived is a separate producer-owned integration contract on first receipt.
preconditions: Provider must be a configured named client; caller cannot supply an upstream URL.
postconditions: No local order, receipt or stock mutation.
failures: Invalid provider: invalid_purchase; invalid SKU: invalid_sku.
Supplier 404: supplier_not_found; timeout/network/invalid quote are adapter errors.
